reports.title: Reports Panel
reports.occupancyDescription: This report shows the number of rooms occupied per day in the selected date range. It helps identify occupancy peaks, high seasons, and low-demand days.
reports.availabilityDescription: This report shows the daily availability of rooms in the selected accommodation during the indicated date range. It quickly identifies days with higher or lower availability, helping to optimize booking management and anticipate high-demand periods.
reports.inventoryDescription: View the current inventory status by room, including available products and those that have reached their minimum allowed. It is useful for maintaining logistical control of the accommodation.
reports.revenuebyWeekDayDescription: This report presents the days of the week (Monday to Sunday) with the highest estimated average revenue for an accommodation within the selected date range. The graph allows visualizing billing trends, identifying revenue peaks, and evaluating the economic performance of the accommodation in specific periods.
reports.revenueDescription: This report presents the estimated average revenue for an accommodation within the selected date range. The graph allows visualizing billing trends, identifying revenue peaks, and evaluating the economic performance of the accommodation in specific periods.
reports.reviewsDescription: This report offers a summary of reviews made by guests, including the average ratings, score distribution, and highlighted comments. It allows evaluating customer satisfaction and identifying improvement opportunities in the accommodation experience.
reports.maintenancesDescription: This report offers a summary of pending or in-progress maintenance tasks for an accommodation.
reports.performanceDescription: This report offers a summary of pending or in-progress maintenance tasks for an accommodation.
reports.summaryDescription: It presents a summary of metrics such as occupancy, revenue by room type, additional services, bookings, and maintenances for the selected accommodation during the indicated date range.
